ollama.json_mode: prompt only; same for both conditions; no schema-constrained decoding
ollama.warmup: one excluded legacy development example, raw output retained

video.coverage_criteria: See REVIEW_RUBRIC.md and each case expected_events; parser detection, dedicated visuals and generic tracking are separate.

java.oracle_failure_policy: stop the suite before inference; never silently drop or relabel samples

generation_order: Program/repetition order shuffled with frozen seed; paired condition order alternates, giving 70 first positions per condition.
controls: 20 paired corrected reference programs; check success gate only, not independent LLM factual-correctness samples

assessment.automatic: schema, rule acceptance, fallback tier, availability, execution outcomes, exact complexity labels, timing and video integrity
assessment.human: author review only; no independent raters, no inter-rater agreement, no learning study
assessment.review_subset: hint cases suffix 03, 06 and 09 in each category; one first-run output per condition; 30 programs
assessment.inference_statistics: paired case-level differences and case bootstrap intervals; repeated generations averaged within program first
assessment.limitations: synthetic author-constructed data, related rule/control-flow families, unknown model pretraining overlap

no_automatic_analysis_claims: Raw data and review sheets do not establish semantic correctness or learning gains. Video clips require manual inspection.
recovery: configuration and source hashes must match; finished cases are retained; failures are not silently rerun; uncertain video submissions require reconciliation
